slides.title: Tell people you know
slides.head: Say what you do in one sentence.
slides.body: "I fix leaking geysers and taps in Paarl" beats "I do plumbing".

slides.title: Make one clear offer
slides.head: Pick the one or two things you do best.
slides.body: Say what they get and roughly what it costs.

slides.title: Be easy to contact
slides.head: One number you answer, WhatsApp on.
slides.body: Use the same name and town everywhere.

slides.title: Show proof
slides.head: Photos of finished jobs.
slides.body: With permission, keep short comments from happy customers.

slides.title: Follow up once
slides.head: If a quote goes quiet, send one friendly message.
slides.body: Many jobs are won this way.
